theme.description: High-Performance Swiss Brutalist. Dark mode optimized for long sessions, focusing on extreme legibility and fast data consumption.

typography.heading_strategy: Tight tracking (tracking-tight), high contrast. No generic sans for headings.
typography.body_strategy: Highly legible geometric sans, generous line height for readability.

rules: Avoid pure black. Use zinc-950 for base dark.
No gradients for standard backgrounds. Do not use transparent backgrounds for headers/dropdowns over content.
Use intense, highly saturated accent colors for lead states to break up monochrome UI.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Neo-Brutalist sharp edges. border-radius: 0px or max 4px. Use 1px sharp borders (border-border/40) for structure.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Rely on 1px solid borders rather than drop shadows on dark mode.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay for empty states or login screens.

grids_and_layouts.strategy: The Bento Grid Protocol (Universal) - High Density Grid
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous internal padding for cards (p-6 to p-8). Tight gap for structural grids.

components.telecaller_view: Split pane layout: Task queue on left (col-span-1), Active Lead/Dialer workspace on right (col-span-3).

components.buttons: Sharp corners, high contrast hover states. Pill shapes ONLY for lead status badges.
components.inputs: Flat, 1px border, no shadow, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary.
components.tables: Dense rows, hover:bg-zinc-900/50, sticky headers. Lead names in font-medium, status in color-coded badges.
components.cards: Flat, rectangular, 1px border. No soft shadows.

motion.strategy: Fast and structural. Quick 150ms ease-out opacity/transform for state changes.
motion.hover: Subtle border color change or background tint.
motion.drawer: Slide in from right, fast transition. Used for Lead detail drawer.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA standards. Text on active buttons must have 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.focus: Visible 2px offset focus ring on all interactive elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

media.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) - crisp, duotone weight for active states, regular for inactive.
media.charts: Recharts (Shadcn chart component). Use the lead_stages colors for data viz.

image_urls.description: Dark geometric abstract shape for login screen backdrop.
Modern office team collaborating, for 'Invite Team' or 'No users yet' states.

instructions_to_main_agent.tech_stack: React, Tailwind, Shadcn/UI primitives. NO TSX, use JS files.
implementation_notes: Ensure Shadcn UI components are installed correctly as JS.
Use sonner for all notifications (e.g., Lead assigned).
Do NOT use HTML <select> or <input type='date'>. Use Shadcn Select and Calendar.
Implement Dark Mode toggle. Default to Dark Mode.
Telecaller workspace must feel like a focused speed-dialer view.
Management screens should prioritize density and quick filtering.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Use Phosphor Icons. NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Always use data-testid for testing hooks.
Use JS extensions for components, not TSX.
